description: Pistol specialization system: two shared three-way module groups plus one weapon-specific signature module per normal pistol family. Unique variants are intentionally excluded.

quick_response.name: Quick-Response Package
quick_response.concept: Turns the PTM into an extreme emergency sidearm with faster draw, aiming and reload at the cost of recoil and wear.

match_barrel.name: Match Barrel Assembly
match_barrel.concept: Pushes the UDP toward a precise mid-range sidearm with tighter dispersion and better effective range at the cost of handling.

automatic_sear.name: Automatic Sear
automatic_sear.concept: Adds automatic fire to the APB's existing three-round burst fire mode using the vanilla ChangeFireTypeEffectBurstAuto effect.

hunting_cylinder.name: Hunting Cylinder
hunting_cylinder.concept: Heavy-hitting Rhino specialization. Exact ammo/effect behavior remains intentionally conservative until its existing 12-gauge conversion path is accounted for.

selectable_fire_control.name: Selectable Fire Control
selectable_fire_control.concept: Adds semi-automatic fire alongside the M10's native automatic mode using the vanilla ChangeFireTypeEffectSemiAuto effect.
